source.name: ArrowLeft must keep moving the caret in other text fields while a calendar is shown
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/Pikaday/Pikaday/pull/710) at 2dc35f0e4d6525de534ce7145f37ae5914d81f23. Blind to the maintainers' fix f52cf7058c0def6fa6776179a78cde2612b1d7b1; routing auto.

journey.title: Correct a typo in the driver note with the left arrow
journey.goal: While the calendar is on the page, ArrowLeft in another text field still moves the caret so the user can fix their text

steps.title: Type the note without a space
Move the caret back one character

functionalJourney.title: Pick a delivery day with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the delivery day

guards.title: Move the delivery day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys in the delivery day field still move the selected day

plan.root_cause: The pikaday keyboard listener attached to document processes ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down keys regardless of which element has focus, preventing normal text field caret movement when the calendar is visible.
plan.repair_strategy: Add an early return in Pikaday._onKeyChange when the bound field is not the active element, so arrow keys only adjust the date picker when the associated input has focus.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can now use left/right arrow keys to correct typos in text fields while the date picker is visible, restoring expected editing behavior.
functional_risks: Arrow keys will no longer change the selected date when focus is outside the bound input (e.g., in other form fields). This is the intended behavior; date navigation via arrow keys remains available when the input itself is focused.
verification_requirements: Press ArrowLeft in the #notes field while the calendar is visible and verify the caret moves left.
Press ArrowRight/Up/Down in the #notes field and verify normal text navigation works.
Focus the #delivery-date field and verify ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Still change the selected date as before.
Confirm that date selection via mouse clicks in the calendar continues to work.
Ensure the calendar still opens/closes correctly and bound field updates on selection.
